text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, they descend the hill at the second 
corner into the backstretch! How is the 
leader's pace looking?

text_block_list.name: Man with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama's turf 2500m goes around six 
corners. On top of that, there's a big 
elevation change, demanding serious 
toughness. It's hard to push through on 
speed alone.

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text: What's with this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Man with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
The "Heartbreak Hill" lies in wait before 
the finish line. How the race unfolds will 
remain unknown until the very moment they 
cross the finish.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone watches the development with 
bated breath. And then—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"She breaks through here! It's Satono 
Diamond! Satono Diamond takes the lead!!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: McQueen & Teio
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Satono Diamond surges up the final hill! 
Soaring past both friend and idol in one 
fell swoop—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond crosses the finish line in 
1st place!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Dia-san. The victory is 
yours.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It seems I have lost even at long 
distance. Your strength is beyond any 
doubt now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Haven't they reached it? The prowess of 
the 'legendary Umamusume' you speak of.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mmmph, Dia-chan and Kita-chan have gotten 
so strong... It's far beyond my 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Teio-san...! I-I'm so happy~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, this isn't the end, you know. If 
anything, it's just the beginning!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"If you stop running, you'll be passed in 
an instant. I intend to challenge all of 
you once more."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Besides, strong girls like those two will 
keep showing up one after another.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I won't let my guard down! To bring 
smiles to everyone's faces, I'm going to 
become stronger and stronger!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Dia-san, what about you? Have you 
decided on the path you will take?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. As an Umamusume of the Satono 
family, I want to lead the way and pave a 
new path in our history.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Let us carve our track record into the 
history of the Umamusume world, and forge 
a new legacy for the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then what kind of path do you 
intend to forge?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—To the summit. True to the name Diamond, 
I intend to challenge the brilliance of 
the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I shall challenge every pinnacle in Japan 
and across the globe, and contribute to 
the advancement of the Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"That is who I am—Satono Diamond's way of 
being as a 'Distinguished Umamusume.'"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I have only just stepped 
through the entrance. Keeping this resolve 
in my heart, I intend to strive toward 
becoming a "legendary Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu, what a splendid aspiration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well then, go show them what a "great 
Umamusume" can do! Everyone is waiting for 
you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for your support!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Diamond-chaaaan!! Congraaaats!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The treasure of the Umamusume world!! No 
brilliance can surpass Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, I always strive to be that way.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume of the Satono family, I, 
Satono Diamond, intend to devote myself to 
the development of the Japanese Umamusume 
world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And that path will continue on—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep taking on challenges 
together with Kita-chan from now on too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even if the races we run are different. 
Even if our goals and paths diverge.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: While walking their respective paths.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep running side-by-side with 
Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's keep running, together!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah!! Together from here on out too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But before that! In the next race!! I'm 
definitely going to beat you, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's my first goal!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufufu! I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Looking good, you two!! I can't 
wait!

text_block_list.name: Man with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
I promise to continue watching over the 
history of Satono, and the history of you 
two!!

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text:
Our hearts are always with you all! We'll 
be cheering for you! Now and forever!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! To receive such warm 
cheers from everyone...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, Dia really is so blessed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying so, Satono Diamond smiled carefree.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
More dazzling than any jewel, even a 
diamond— that is the radiance of Satono 
Diamond.
